about: Words the matcher uses, as data. Phrases are matched as whole words, without regard to case. Each list names where its words come from: the project owner's matching rules and cases (docs: rule N / case N) or the design (DESIGN 3.3).

specUnits.source: owner rule 24 and case 7 (DC-600 KHZ, 0-1500V, 50kv, 10Hz-50 MHz, 100:1, 15 MEG, 4 channels)

lot.source: owner rule 4 ("lot of", quantities), case 1 (LOT OF 13 ...); DESIGN 3.3 (2x)

partWords.source: owner rule 14 (several model codes + part words: knobs, feet, cover, cord) and case 4; alone they do not make a part (live 2026-10-19: "IM-13 VTVM (NEEDS CORD!)" is the item)

withItem.source: owner case 1: the real comp "... w/ Leads" is the item with its leads, not an accessory

conditions.source: owner rules 5, 18 and 22, cases 1, 5, 6, 8; the level of "powered on" (untested) is a placement for the owner to confirm

ebayConditions.source: condition texts seen on eBay pages (recon: search card subtitles "Pre-Owned", "Brand New"; item JSON-LD UsedCondition; live 2026-10-19 card subtitles "New (Other)", "Parts Only")
